sierra-high-route.why: The pages differ: Backpacking Routes gives late July to mid-September, and Skurka warns the route is off-limits to all but expert mountaineers from November through May. It was set by judgement from both and from the climate at the passes, which are near 12,000 feet.
sierra-high-route.months_text: The Skurka page says the route is probably off-limits to all but the most experienced mountaineers from November through May and lists hazards by month; Backpacking Routes gives late July to mid-September

sources.quote: For all but the most experienced mountaineers, the SHR is probably off-limits from November through May
The best time to hike the Sierra High Route is late July to mid-September.

cohos.why: The pages differ: The Trek gives May to October and Backpacking Routes gives June to November. It was set by judgement from both and from the climate, since snow and mud last into late May and cold sets in by late October.

ouachita.why: The pages differ: one gives April to November, one gives late October to late March, and one gives all year. It was set by judgement from all three and from the climate, since summers are hot and humid with ticks and winters are cold but walkable.
ouachita.months_text: The Hiking Life 4-11; Backpacking Routes 10-3; The Trek 1-12

sources.quote: Late October through late March is very possible, with the bulk of the hikers hitting it in November.

ice-age.why: The pages differ: one Trek page gives summer and fall and another gives summer only. It was set by judgement from both and from the climate, since snow and mud last through April and a hard freeze comes by November.
ice-age.months_text: The Trek list 6-11; The Trek article 6-8

sources.quote: The Ice Age Trail Best Time: Summer

ozark-trail.why: The pages differ: one Trek page gives spring or fall and another adds winter. It was set by judgement from both and from the climate, since the heat, humidity and ticks of July and August make summer a poor choice.
ozark-trail.months_text: The Trek article 3-5 and 9-11; The Trek list 12-5 and 9-11

finger-lakes.why: The pages differ: one Trek page gives winter, spring, summer and fall, and a table on the same page gives spring, summer and fall. It was set by judgement from both and from the climate, since snow lies from December to March and early spring is muddy.
finger-lakes.months_text: The Trek trail entry 1-12; The Trek table 3-11

sources.quote: Hiking season: Winter, Spring, Summer, Fall
